column1: Track behaviour, not vanity activity. These four metrics predict revenue better than raw call counts. Update weekly, per rep.
What good looks like: fast Grade A response, high follow-up completion, working the queue in order (not just the newest lead), and ₹ recovered trending up.
Coach on the specific signal, not effort: 'this Grade A lead sat 9 hours' is a conversation a rep can act on. Leadkaun computes all four automatically - https://leadkaun.com
